data_description.pid_kp: How strongly PumpSteer reacts to current temperature error. Typical range: 2.0 to 5.0.
data_description.pid_ki: How much PumpSteer corrects long-term drift. Typical range: 0.01 to 0.05.
data_description.pid_kd: How much PumpSteer reacts to fast temperature changes. Keep at 0.0 unless you tune it intentionally.
data_description.pid_integral_clamp: Limits built-up long-term correction to reduce windup. Typical range: 5.0 to 10.0.
data_description.pid_output_clamp: Caps how many degrees PumpSteer may adjust the setpoint.
data_description.notify_service: Leave empty to use persistent notifications in the HA sidebar instead.
data_description.preheat_boost_enabled: When enabled, PumpSteer heats extra before expensive periods to build up thermal mass.
data_description.ohmigo_entity: PumpSteer will push the fake outdoor temperature to this number entity after each update. Leave empty to disable. Toggle without reconfiguring using the 'Ohmigo Push' switch.
data_description.ohmigo_interval_minutes: Minimum time between pushes to Ohmigo. Default 5 minutes. Changes below 0.2 °C are treated as unchanged, but the current setpoint is resent when the interval is due to keep the Ohmigo watchdog alive.
data_description.modbus_service: Home Assistant service to call, for example modbus.write_register, mqtt.publish or input_number.set_value.
data_description.modbus_payload_template: YAML payload template for the service call. The template can use the fake_temp variable.
data_description.modbus_interval_minutes: Minimum time between Generic Output System service calls.
data_description.ohmigo_relay_entity: Optional switch entity for the Ohmigo Active/Bypass relay. When configured, PumpSteer exposes a separate Relay Guard switch. The guard only recovers an explicit OFF state while Ohmigo Push is ON; unknown or unavailable states never cause a relay command.
